description: Driving south on the Saline Valley Road, from the Inyo National Forest towards the washboard road of Waucoba Wash in the eastern Inyo Mountains to the Saline Valley and Death Valley National Park.

Newsreels in which Dutch subjects of a certain week are presented.; Appeal to the viewers to be extremely careful when passing an unguarded railway crossing. SHOTS: - newspaper reports mention traffic accidents at railway crossings; - various shots of trains which pass various overpass and level railway crossings; the last category is divided into guarded (with railroad barriers), protected (flashing light installations) and ungaurded; - various road traffic and pedestrians pass various level railway crossings; - a viaduct near the station of Leiden is under construction; - at Heiloo installations with half (instead of whole) railroad barriers are submitted to a trial run; - a few shots of cars which drove into railroad barriers; - various shots show how it shouldn't be done.
